visual.general_description: Two side-by-side echocardiographic-style frames titled for correct and incorrect Impella catheter position, with arrows and chamber labels.
visual.detailed_description: Wide composite of two framed sector images side by side on a pale blue background. The left frame has a blue title reading "Correct Impella® Catheter Position (Color Doppler TTE)" and the right frame has a blue title reading "Incorrect Impella® Catheter Position (Color Doppler TTE)". Each frame is a black sector image with a dark header band carrying burned-in text (a name field, an ID-like field, a date and time field, a transducer/preset label and a manufacturer logo; these name, ID and date fields belong to a manufacturer illustration, not to either patient), a settings column at the upper left, a gray scale bar at the right and a printed heart rate of 80 bpm at the lower right. White text labels mark "RV" in the upper part, "LV" at the left-center, "LA" at the lower center and "AV" at the right, with white outlined arrows pointing from the "Impella" label to a thin bright catheter line and from "AV" to a yellow-green color-flow patch. In the left frame the catheter line, with a curled tip, runs from the left-center region toward the valve region and the color-flow patch is a compact patch at the valve. In the right frame the catheter line is shorter and lies toward the left side with its arrow pointing downward onto it, and the color-flow patch is larger and sits to the left of the valve label. No other numeric measurements are visible.
